pages.title: Decision, reason and pending item
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Meeting notes · simulated source
pages.subject: The event cannot use the original quote
paragraphs: The team has decided not to proceed with the event on the original basis. The quoted cost is $5,400 against a budget limit of $5,000. A later supplier option is estimated at $4,800, but its available date has not yet been confirmed. The decision is to postpone while checking that option, not to treat the lower figure as an approved booking.

The meeting also covered colours and several discarded formats. Those details remain in the full notes but do not alter the current decision. The immediate dependency is the supplier’s date. Once it is known, funding can be reviewed and the rota organiser can ask for availability. These are simulated notes, not an actual spending request.

pages.title: What the recipients need
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Audience cards · simulated source
pages.subject: Funding and rota planning
paragraphs: The funding decision-maker needs to know whether the proposed spend fits the limit and what decision is being requested. An update that starts with the whole meeting chronology may hide the relevant comparison. The rota organiser needs an accurate date and the status of its confirmation before asking people to change their plans.

Both recipients must receive the same underlying facts. Adapting the briefing means changing emphasis, not removing an inconvenient uncertainty or implying that a provisional date is final. A useful next-step sentence names who should do what and when the dependency will be checked. The complete meeting notes remain available if either person needs the supporting detail.

pages.title: The supplier date is confirmed
pages.instruction: Listen to both voice notes, then answer and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. The supplier has confirmed that the lower quote of four thousand eight hundred is available on the thirteenth of December. The budget limit remains five thousand. That resolves the pending supplier date, but it doesn’t automatically confirm the team’s availability or authorise the spending. Could you update both briefings?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. The supplier has confirmed that the lower quote of four thousand eight hundred is available on the thirteenth of December. The budget limit remains five thousand. additionalAudios.audioText: The funding person now has a costed option to review; the rota organiser can ask who is available for that date. Please preserve the distinction between a supplier confirmation and our own final event confirmation. We don’t need to repeat the colour discussion or every abandoned suggestion. A useful summary gives the decision, its reason and the next action for this particular recipient.
